newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms buy 16,000 tns U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms buy 16,000 tns U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour millers Delta Milling Corp and Morning Star Corp bought a total of 16,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for February shipment, traders said on Friday.

The two firms clinched a deal for 13,000 tonnes of western white wheat from Mitsubishi Corp and 3,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat from U.S. trading giant Cargill late on Wednesday, two traders privy to the deal told Reuters.
The prices at which the firms bought the wheat were not immediately available. --Manila newsroom (632) 841-89-36
